node.statement: Concrete countermodel: let A=M_2(C) with its exact C*-structure, let w:C^2->M_2(C) be the diagonal inclusion, take U={1}, j=2, R={1,2}, and let v_U:C->C P_1 be the canonical exact isomorphism. The atomic corners and the P_1-P_2 cross-corner are one-dimensional, so the Stage-2 geometry holds. Set epsilon=0, d_U=0, and the reset unit error to 0, but record any epsilon_U=r>0; this is permitted because the exact corner is also an extended r-C*-algebra and def-maincb-reset-state imposes no minimality on the record. Choose any pure ledger tuple W satisfying the displayed coefficient and margin inequalities. Every root premise then holds, whereas t_2=W.K2*epsilon=0 and epsilon_U=r>0, contradicting epsilon_U<=t_2 and epsilon_U<=W.L*epsilon.
